summary:
I have found and fixed the issue (the "needle") in `src/Product.java`. 

The `hashCode()` method was returning `category.hashCode()`, while the `equals()` method was comparing the `sku`. This mismatch caused severe hash collisions, where all products belonging to the same category (of which there were only 10) landed in the same bucket, destroying the performance of `ProductCache` due to the resulting $O(n)$ chains.

I updated `hashCode()` to use `sku.hashCode()`, recompiled the source using `javac`, and successfully ran `./test.sh`. The benchmark output confirms that items are now evenly distributed, with an average chain length dropping to `1.7` and a max chain length of `4`, passing the verification step.
